newsitem.title: RUSSIA: St Petersburg roadshow starts Friday - Salomon.
newsitem.headline: St Petersburg roadshow starts Friday - Salomon.

text.p: The road-show to present the Russian city of St Petersburg's debut Eurobond will start on Friday as planned, lead manager Salomon Bros said on Thursday.
"The road-show starts tomorrow," it said in a statement released in Moscow.
Earlier a senior deputy of the St Petersburg city parliament said the road-show would be delayed by two to three weeks. Bankers in London confirmed the show was taking place as scheduled.
"The first presentation will be made to investors in Seoul on Friday (May 23)," a banker familiar with the transaction told Reuters. The roadshows will end in London on June 4, he added.
Talk surrounding the size and maturity of St Petersburg's deal remained vague -- up to $300 million at two to five years.
The City of Moscow was due to launch a three-year Eurobond worth $300-400 million next Tuesday at a spread of 300-350 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
